text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Foreign Affairs Minister Zouari visits Germany for talks with German Foreign Minister Kinkel on increasing bilateral cooperation, Middle East peace process.
- High Education Minister Jazi says 120,000 students attend Tunisia's universities.
- Imports of computer equipment amounted to 461 million dinars ($461 million) between 1992 and 1996.
